criteria.hypothesis: SNpp16 selectively drives the DVM motor neurons
criteria.G1: mean DVMn 1a-c non-decreasing in k, tolerance 0.5 Hz
criteria.G2: some k gives mean DVMn in 2.0-12.0 Hz; smallest such k is k*
criteria.G3: at k*: mean steering, b1 and DLMn c-f each below 1 Hz
criteria.G4: at k*: rewired null gives DVMn below 1 Hz
criteria.G5: at k*: DVMn in band in at least 4 of 5 draws
